description: Composite Spitfire XVIII: fuselage HS-674 (ex-RAF TP370) with parts marked HS-683 (ex-TP370/TP263 per WBI/Peter Arnold); gifted 1962 by AVM Harjinder Singh, dismantled in the 1970s and kept indoors as a teaching airframe (WBI). Not on public view.
First-batch (1971) Mi-8 handed over by 3 BRD on 29 Jan 2004 and installed on the PEC campus (WBI). Coordinates 30.76528 76.78624 per WBI.
AVM Harjinder Singh personal Auster Aiglet, donated 25 Oct 1989, kept in the aero labs (WBI).
MiG-21M recorded by Bharat Rakshak as preserved at PEC Chandigarh; not photo-verified.
